triage_candidates.statement: Fuel confound in grip curve: race_degradation_slopes fits a global fuel term but returns only per-compound wear slopes, so g2's wear-corrected pace still carries fuel burn-off (absorbed by curve+offset; surfaced by curve_offset_correlation). CONFIRMED genuine, honestly-scoped limitation (de-fuel would require reimplementing the forbidden OLS body), not a hidden defect. Future: expose fuel coeff as an additive return field.

sessions.rainfall schema/storage mismatch: schema.sql declares REAL but the collector writes an 8-byte little-endian int64 blob (wet-sample count). CONFIRMED on real 2023 data (Netherlands=48, Monaco=26 wet; Bahrain/Australia=0 dry) -- decode is correct. Consider session_surface_features.session_rain_flag (INTEGER, already populated) as the canonical repo-wide rain source, or fix the schema type.
